name: Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit
insider_take: This ultra-luxury all-inclusive sits on pristine Banderas Bay, where the Sierra Madre mountains cascade directly into the Pacific Ocean.
whats_special: Grand Velas Riviera Nayarit is Mexico's first all-inclusive resort to earn AAA Five Diamond status. The property features three distinct sections - adults-only Grand Class, family-friendly Ambassador, and Master suites - each with exclusive amenities. You'll find award-winning spas, world-class dining by Michelin-starred chefs, and suites averaging 1,200 square feet with private terraces and plunge pools.
pro_tip: Book the Grand Class section for the most exclusive experience - it includes access to a private beach club, premium spirits, and personalized butler service.
dont_miss: The nearby Marieta Islands, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve perfect for snorkeling and spotting humpback whales (December-March). Also explore charming Puerto Vallarta's historic downtown, just 45 minutes away, famous for its cobblestone streets and vibrant art scene.
pros: All-inclusive luxury with world-class spa facilities
Multiple gourmet restaurants with Michelin-quality dining
Three distinct sections catering to different guest preferences
Stunning oceanfront location on pristine Riviera Nayarit beaches
cons: Large resort property may feel less intimate
